Name: Rovesta Guard
SpecialAttacks: panache (2 points), precise strike (+5 damage), swashbuckler weapon training +1
Feats: Weapon Focus, Fencing Grace, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Specialization, Improved Critical
Special Abilities:
Precise Strike (Ex): As long as the guard has at least 1 panache point, they gain the ability to strike with pinpoint accuracy. When making a melee attack with a light or one-handed piercing weapon (such as their rapier), they deal an extra 5 points of precision damage (equal to their swashbuckler level). This bonus damage is not multiplied on a critical hit and does not apply against creatures immune to sneak attacks.
Panache (Ex): The guard begins each day with 2 panache points. They regain 1 panache point each time they confirm a critical hit with a rapier or reduce a creature to 0 or fewer hit points with a rapier attack.
Charmed Life (Ex): Three times per day as an immediate action before attempting a saving throw, the guard can add their Charisma modifier (+2) to the result of that saving throw.
Nimble +1 (Ex): The guard gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC while wearing light or no armor.

Senses: darkvision 60 ft., life sight 30 ft., Perception +15
Melee: bite +14 (2d6+9/19-20 plus 1d8 negative energy & necrotic wither), tail slap +12 (1d8+4 plus trip)
SpecialAttacks: gaze (turn to stone permanently, 30 ft., Fort DC 19), necrotic wither (DC 19, 1d4 Str/Dex), petrifying ash breath (30-ft cone, 6d6 neg energy & slow, 3/day, DC 19)
Feats: Improved Initiative, Improved Critical (bite), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (bite)
SQ: channel resistance +4, petrifying death gaze, unholy resilience
Immune: cold, petrification, poison, paralysis, undead traits
Environment: ancient catacombs, corrupted caverns, and desolate petrified forests
Special Abilities:
Petrifying Gaze (Su) Turn to stone permanently (as flesh to stone), range 30 feet, Fortitude DC 19 negates. A creature petrified in this manner that is then coated (not just splashed) with fresh basilisk blood/ichor (taken from an undead basilisk no more than 1 hour destroyed) is instantly restored to flesh. A single basilisk contains enough blood to coat 1d3 Medium creatures in this manner. When a living creature fails this save against an Undead Basilisk, its petrified form is tainted with necrotic energy, causing it to suffer 1 negative level in addition to becoming petrified. The save DC is Charisma-based.
Necrotic Wither (Su) Bite-injury; save Fort DC 19; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d4 Strength damage and 1d4 Dexterity damage; cure 2 consecutive saves.
Petrifying Ash Breath (Su) 3/day, exhales a 30-ft cone of necrotic ash dealing 6d6 negative energy damage and coating creatures in petrifying crust (slowed for 1d4 rounds, Reflex DC 19 half damage and negates slow).

Name: Orchid Giant Mantis
Skills: Climb +12, Fly +0, Perception +10, Stealth +6 (+14 in floral or vegetated terrain)
Special Abilities:
Floral Camouflage (Ex) The orchid giant mantis gains a +8 racial bonus on Stealth checks (+16 in floral or vegetated terrain). When motionless among flora, it can take 20 on Stealth and hide while observed.
Lunge (Ex) As a standard action, or when making an attack of opportunity, the mantis can extend its forelegs, increasing its reach with its claws to 15 feet until the end of that attack.
Mandibles (Ex) When the mantis begins its turn maintaining a grapple on a foe, it automatically hits the grappled opponent with its bite attack (+7 melee, 1d8+4 damage) in addition to normal grapple damage.
Sudden Strike (Ex) During a surprise round, the orchid giant mantis can act as if it were taking a full round of actions, allowing it to make a full attack against flat-footed targets.

Name: Frost Roc
Melee: 2 talons +18 (2d6+10 plus 1d6 cold and grab), bite +18 (2d8+10 plus 1d6 cold)
SpecialAttacks: blizzard wing (60-ft. cone, 8d6 cold, DC 22), glacial snatch, rend (2 talons, 2d6+16 plus 2d6 cold)
Special Abilities:
Blizzard Wing (Su) Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, the Frost Roc beats its colossal rime-encrusted wings, releasing a swirling vortex of frost and freezing hail in a 60-foot cone dealing 8d6 points of cold damage (DC 22 Reflex save for half). The save DC is Constitution-based.
Frigid Aura (Su) The Frost Roc radiates intense sub-zero cold. Any creature within 20 feet takes 1d6 points of cold damage at the beginning of the Roc's turn.
Snow Vision (Ex) A Frost Roc can see perfectly through falling snow, blizzards, and freezing fog without taking any penalties to Perception checks or ranged attacks.
Glacial Snatch (Ex) When a Frost Roc successfully grapples a creature of Huge size or smaller with its talons, it can move at its full flying speed while carrying the victim without taking any encumbrance penalty.
Icewalking (Ex) This ability works like the spider climb spell, but the surfaces the Frost Roc climbs must be icy or frosty. It can move across icy surfaces without needing to make Acrobatics checks and does not treat ice as difficult terrain.

Organization: solitary or troop leader (1 chieftain plus 4-10 dire apes)
Languages: Ape (primal gestures), understands crude Common and Orc
